title: Logistics Assistant
description:
Job Title: Logistics Assistant

Location: Santiago, Región Metropolitana de Santiago, Chile

Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Logistics Assistant to join our client's team in the logistics sector. In this role, you will contribute to ensuring smooth and efficient operations by managing shipments, maintaining vendor and customer relationships, and overseeing inventory accuracy.

Responsibilities

  • Receive shipments and ensure both quality and quantity are met.
  • Trace, track, and expedite purchase processes.
  • Create and maintain contact with vendors and customers to ensure timely delivery of goods.
  • Interact with third-party logistics service providers.
  • Ensure accuracy of all inventories.
  • Review bills, invoices, and purchase orders.
  • Ensure all payments are processed on time.
  • Assist customers with inquiries.
  • Create packing lists and update shipment information in the database.
  • Organize files both manually and electronically.
  • Monitor and facilitate repair orders.
  • Coordinate deliveries for repaired or returned items.
  • Ensure that the warehouse has sufficient space for incoming deliveries.
  • Ensure that all items are properly numbered and tagged.
  • Conduct safety procedures for outbound shipment vehicles.
  • Reconcile hand receipts.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in logistics or supply chain management.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Proficiency in inventory management software and databases.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications (if any)

  • Experience with logistics service providers.
  • Knowledge of safety procedures for shipment vehicles.

Salary & Benefits (Optional)

Competitive salary based on experience. Benefits include health coverage, training opportunities, and a supportive work environment.

title: Industrial/Mechanical Engineer
description:
bout the Company

A fast-growing design and manufacturing company specializing in consumer products is looking for an experienced Industrial / Mechanical Engineer to scale and improve its next-generation production lines. The company combines technology, simplicity, and beautiful design to deliver products customers love — and is investing heavily in smarter, more efficient manufacturing.

About the Role

This position focuses on developing, optimizing, and scaling global manufacturing processes. You will transform product designs into robust, repeatable production systems while reducing cost and improving quality. The role involves close collaboration with suppliers, factory partners, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end manufacturing process across global partners.
  • Onboard and support new production sites, ensuring stable daily operations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and manufacturing partners.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives and resolve production issues rapidly.
  • Design and implement manufacturing tools, jigs, fixtures, and light automation.
  • Support new product launches from prototype to full-scale production.
  • Analyze data to drive cost reduction and process optimization.
  • The position requires on-site visits to production facilities approximately 25–30% of the time.

Requirements

  • BSc in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, QA/QC, or production development.
  • Strong understanding of industrial manufacturing processes and supplier management.
  • Experience with CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion, or Onshape).
  • Analytical and hands-on mindset with excellent execution skills.
  • Self-driven and effective in remote work environments.
  • Interest in sustainable and design-focused consumer products is a plus.

If you like solving real manufacturing problems and seeing the results in the product, we'd love to meet you!
